const SCROLL_TIMINGS: Readonly<{
  SCROLL_DURATION_FULL: 1000;
  SCROLL_DURATION_REDUCED: 2500;
  SCROLL_INIT_DELAY: 500;
}>;

Defined in: core/tokens/media/dimensions.ts:112

Frozen scroll-timing map (ms) — SCROLL_DURATION_FULL paces animated page scrolls, SCROLL_DURATION_REDUCED is the slower ramp under prefers-reduced-motion (longer, gentler rather than instant so the jump stays perceivable), SCROLL_INIT_DELAY defers scroll restoration until after first paint settles.
